newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - South Carolina.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - South Carolina.

text.p: OF THE STATE OF SOUTH CAROLINA
Sealed bids for the purchase of $8,500,000 State

Institution Bonds, Series 1997B (Issued on Behalf of Clemson University) of the State of South Carolina (the "State"), will be received at the Office of the State Treasurer, in Room 121 of the Wade Hampton Office Building, Capitol Complex, Columbia, South Carolina, until 11:00 a.m. (South Carolina time), on

at which time and place the bids will be opened for the purchase at a price of not less than the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds and accrued interest of the Bonds, dated June 1, 1997, maturing on June 1 of each year as follows:
Interest on the Bonds will be payable semiannually on June 1 and December 1 of each year, commencing December 1, 1997. The Bonds are general obligations of the State of South Carolina.
The Bonds are subject to redemption at the option of the State on the terms and conditions as set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement.

The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest net interest cost (NIC) in accordance with the terms set forth in the Official Notice of Sale. A
good faith deposit (in the form of a cashier's check or a surety bond as provided for in the Official Notice of Sale) of $85,000 is a condition of bidding.

The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry-only system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which will act as security depository for the Bonds. The State will furnish the Bonds and the legal opinions of The Honorable Charles M. Condon, Attorney General of the State of South Carolina, and of Sinkler & Boyd, P.A., Bond Counsel for the State, on or about June 25, 1997. Requests for copies of the Official Notice of Sale herein summarized, the Bid Form, and the Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds may be obtained from Mr. Chuck Sanders, Senior Assistant State Treasurer, Wade
Hampton Office Building, Capitol Complex, Columbia, Carolina 29201, telephone (803) 734-2114.
